readerCopy.body: The old version of you may fit so easily that nobody notices you have outgrown it. The Sun trine the South Node can make an established role, talent, or public identity feel effortless and reassuring. Other people may gladly hand you the work you are known for, and you may be able to do it without much strain. Ease is useful information, but it is not the same as relevance. Keep the strength. Let the identity built around it become optional.
